description: Defines a React context provider for managing shopping cart state, including functions to add, update, remove, clear, and checkout the cart, with data fetched from external APIs.

methods.name: CartProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component that provides cart state and actions to its children using React Context.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a product with specified quantity to the cart, then triggers cart reload.

methods.name: updateCart
methods.description: Updates quantity of a product in the cart, then triggers cart reload.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart, then triggers cart reload.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears the entire cart, then triggers cart reload.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Completes the checkout process through the API, then triggers cart reload.
